items.title: What is happening to jobs? Separating AI hype from reality

items.title: Writemark, a dependency free web component for inline Markdown editing
items.raw_excerpt: I like writing Markdown, but do not like writing it inside a plain textarea. I wanted something I could use anywhere by dropping in a single web component: ``` ``` That became Writemark. It renders Markdown while you write, but Markdown remains the value you read, store, and submit. It also has source, split, and preview modes, along with slash commands, tables, task lists, code blocks, native form support, and an API for adding your own controls. There are no runtime dependencies and no required framework or built in toolbar. It is fully vibecoded. The process was very iterative. I knocked something out, tried using it, found bugs, fixed them, and repeated that cycle until I had something I liked writing in and that performed reasonably well. It did not begin as an experiment about AI gen

items.title: The New AI Superpowers: Focus and Followthrough
items.raw_excerpt: The article discusses that focus and followthrough are the key superpowers in AI, outweighing technical prowess. Future AI dominance will belong to organizations that can concentrate resources and persistently execute.

title_i18n.en: The New AI Superpowers: Focus and Followthrough
title_i18n.zh: 新AI超级力量：专注与贯彻
title_i18n.es: Los nuevos superpoderes de la IA: Enfoque y Seguimiento

excerpt_i18n.en: The article discusses that focus and followthrough are the key superpowers in AI, outweighing technical prowess. Future AI dominance will belong to organizations that can concentrate resources and persistently execute.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 本文探讨了在AI领域取得成功的关键因素，认为专注和执行力比技术本身更重要。作者指出，未来AI的超级力量将属于那些能够集中资源并持续跟进的组织。
